content: Base feature set in personal nix-config flakes (6+ repos surveyed: usrrname/dotfiles, zekzekus/dotfiles, rasmus-kirk/nix-config, ratachapada/nix, ahmedelgabri/dotfiles, moons-14/dotfiles): near-universal core = flake.nix entrypoint with tiny mkHost/mkNixos helper; hosts/<name>/ per-host dirs; home/ shared HM modules; modules/ reusable modules. Core managed programs: git (programs.git), shell (bash/zsh + starship/fzf), tmux, one editor (vim/neovim), CLI essentials (ripgrep, fzf, fd, bat, btop, unzip, curl). zekzekus adopts a 'headless-safe base' where home.nix+modules/base ships no GUI and graphical stuff is opt-in via profiles/roles; hosts += profiles list. Layering consensus: core (hard rule) -> optional -> host-specific overrides. Rebuild UX: shell aliases/Makefile/Justfile wrappers (switch/update/edit-secrets commands). Secrets: sops-nix or agenix, plus disko/impermanence on NixOS (out of scope here).
